Public nested mapping of spending allowances, decremented without SafeMath in transferFrom.

Minimum sale amount enforced by condition().
Maximum sale amount enforced by condition().

Per-address sale counter incremented without overflow protection.

Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Core transfer routine performing unchecked balance, allowance and counter updates.

Whitelist and condition gate; privileged addresses bypass all sale restrictions.
Applies _minSale/_maxSale/_saleNum checks to non-whitelisted senders.

balanceOf[_from] -= _value performed without SafeMath.
balanceOf[_to] += _value performed without SafeMath.
uint total = _value * _tos.length performed without SafeMath.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed without SafeMath.
balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**decimals) performed without SafeMath.
_onSaleNum[_from]++ performed without overflow protection.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total performed without SafeMath.
token*(10**decimals) and maxToken*(10**decimals) performed without SafeMath.
_from parameter of transferFrom/transfer, address whose balance and allowance are consumed.
_to parameter of transferFrom/transfer, address receiving the balance.
_value parameter of transferFrom/transfer, amount to move.
_spender parameter of approve, key of the allowance mapping.
Parameter a of delegate(), the arbitrary delegatecall target address.
Parameter b of delegate(), the arbitrary delegatecall calldata.
saleNum parameter of init(), assigned to _saleNum.
token parameter of init(), scaled into _minSale.
maxToken parameter of init(), scaled into _maxSale.
spender parameter of _mints(), recipient of the minted balance.
addedValue parameter of _mints(), amount multiplied by 10**decimals.
_tos array parameter of batchSend(), recipients of the mass transfer.
addr parameter of setTradeAddress(), stored into tradeAddress.
_supply parameter of the constructor, scaled into totalSupply.
Local total in batchSend holding the unchecked product of _value and _tos.length.
Local _UNI in ensure() holding the computed Uniswap pair address used as a whitelist entry.

edges.reason: transfer() forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom calls ensure() before applying balance updates; whitelisted senders bypass all restrictions.
ensure() computes the expected Uniswap pair address via pairFor().
ensure() falls back to condition() only when the sender is not whitelisted.
ensure() compares _from/_to with owner and grants an unconditional bypass.
ensure() treats tradeAddress as a trusted sender that skips checks.
ensure() grants bypass to any address flagged in canSale.
ensure() grants bypass to the hardcoded UNI router address.
condition() reads the _minSale threshold.
condition() reads the _maxSale threshold.
condition() reads the _saleNum limit.
msg.sender decides whether a third party's allowance is spent inside transferFrom.
approve() writes the allowance mapping keyed by msg.sender.
delegate() authorizes arbitrary delegatecall solely on msg.sender == owner.
_mints() authorizes minting with an owner-or-hardcoded-address check on msg.sender.
init() gates sale-limit configuration on msg.sender == owner.
batchSend() gates mass transfers on msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress() gates whitelist updates on msg.sender == owner.
msg.sender balances are read and written in transfer, batchSend and _mints.
msg.sender keys the allowance mapping in transferFrom and approve.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, the only authorization source.
delegate() executes delegatecall with caller-supplied address and data after only an owner check.
Parameter a is the attacker-controlled target of the delegatecall.
Parameter b is the attacker-controlled calldata of the delegatecall.
transferFrom decrements the sender balance without SafeMath, allowing underflow.
transferFrom increments the recipient balance without SafeMath, allowing overflow.
transferFrom decrements the allowance without SafeMath.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum without overflow protection.
batchSend multiplies _value by _tos.length without SafeMath, enabling overflow.
batchSend subtracts total from msg.sender's balance without SafeMath.
_mints assigns addedValue*(10**decimals) without SafeMath.
init scales token and maxToken by 10**decimals without SafeMath.
_from is the address whose balance is decremented and whose allowance is checked.
_to is the address whose balance is incremented.
_value is the unchecked amount subtracted from the sender balance.
_value is the unchecked amount subtracted from the allowance.
_value is compared against _minSale and _maxSale inside condition().
_from drives the whitelist test inside ensure().
_to drives the whitelist test inside ensure().
_spender is the key written in the allowance mapping by approve().
spender is the recipient credited with the minted balance in _mints.
addedValue is the unchecked multiplier in the mint assignment.
_tos.length feeds the unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
Each element of _tos receives an unchecked balance increment.
Local total carries the unchecked product into the balance subtraction.
Local _UNI is an additional address whitelisted by ensure().
addr is written into the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
The constructor grants infinite allowance to the hardcoded Uniswap router.
The constructor sets the owner state variable.
The constructor sets totalSupply.
_supply is scaled into totalSupply.
saleNum is assigned to _saleNum in init().
token is scaled into _minSale in init().
maxToken is scaled into _maxSale in init().

normalization_plan.reason: _from is only meaningful as the input address consumed by transferFrom; merge into the function node.
_to is only meaningful as the destination address mutated by transferFrom.
_value is the amount operated on exclusively inside transferFrom.
_spender exists only as the key written by approve().
The delegatecall target address is fully captured by the delegatecall unsafe operation node.
The delegatecall calldata is fully captured by the delegatecall unsafe operation node.
saleNum is used only to configure state inside init().
token is used only to configure _minSale inside init().
maxToken is used only to configure _maxSale inside init().
spender is only used as the credited account inside _mints().
addedValue is the operand of the unchecked multiplication in _mints().
_tos is consumed by the unchecked multiplication in batchSend().
addr is only stored into the tradeAddress whitelist by setTradeAddress().
_supply is only used during construction to set totalSupply.
Local total is the temporary operand of the unchecked balance subtraction.
Local _UNI is a computed whitelist value used only inside ensure().
